text:
opsbot: Incident detected: prefilling containers in us-west-2 experiencing GPU OOMs -> container restart loop (~12/min). Affected pool: prod-model-1b-llama, model variant: llm-large-context. Prefill length spike observed (>200k tokens in some requests).

opsbot: Alert tags: severity=sev2, symptoms=OOM+SIGKILL, metric=container_restarts, region=us-west-2

opsbot: Recent log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T03:21:05Z] cuda: out of memory allocating 3.1GiB
[2026-03-17T03:21:05Z] runtime: prefill failed, kvcache_alloc=9.8GiB limit=10.0GiB
[2026-03-17T03:21:05Z] containerd: process exited with status 137
```

mika: I'm oncall. paging @jordan and @anya. what's current customer impact?

jordan: seeing 5xx spike on generation endpoint in us-west-2, error rate ~6% at peak. One enterprise (Acme Corp) reported production errors.

anya: I can patch runtime to trim KV during prefill. immediate mitigation: reduce prefetch to 4 and enable prefill-trim policy. Will push config change to canary.

mika: set hail mary: route traffic away from prod-model-1b-llama pool while we mitigate.

jordan: running command to reduce prefetch on pool:
```
redwoodctl pools set prod-us-west-2 --prefetch 4 --prefetch-window 2048
``` 
Applied to 2/6 nodes (canary).

infra-bot: container_restarts (prod-us-west-2): 12 -> 8 -> 2 after canary change (10m windows).

anya: pushed runtime hotfix v1.13.4-canary with kv-trim during prefill (aggressiveness=high). Canary nodes stable for 8m with no restarts. Preparing rollout to remaining nodes.

csm: I've notified Acme and Zeta. Acme saw ~15% failed requests for a 7-minute window. Zeta hit 3% and is ok with rollback to smaller model for now.

sre-lead: good. next steps: 1) finish rollout of hotfix to remaining nodes 2) enable circuit-breaker per-tenant for >60s prefill 3) create follow-up postmortem and customer-impact blurb.

mika: I'll take on the incident writeup and pager notes. tagging @csm for customer comms. If rollout remains stable for 15m, close incident.

jordan: rolling to remaining 4 nodes now.

opsbot: Incident update: mitigated -> in stabilization. current error rate 0.6% (baseline 0.2%).

mika: thanks team. filing follow-up: reduce default prefetch for long-context models and add prefill max-kv cap in runtime config.
